act_title: The Central Industrial Security Force  Act, 1968
title: Application of Act 22 of 1922 to officers and members of the Force
text:
19. Application of Act 22 of 1922 to officers and members of the Force.—The Police (Incitement

to Disaffection) Act, 1922, shall apply to members of the Force as it applies to members of a police
force.
